payload.body_you: {{holder1}} says they will call, make the reservation, send the information, or handle their part. You are paying attention to what happens next. A promise means less when you are still the person following up, remembering the date, or fixing the part that did not get done.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} is paying attention to what you actually do. You keep the plan, return the call, remember the date, or handle your part without {{holder1}} having to remind you. That can matter more than another conversation about what you intended to do.
